title: Login Outage
description: Users were unable to log in due to authentication failures.

timeline.description: Authentication service logs showing repeated login failures.
23 user-submitted tickets reporting login issues.
MI proposed by Internal Applications.
Manager approved the incident as a Major Incident (MI).
User-facing banner added: 'We are aware of a login issue and investigating.'
War room channel and call created for MI discussion.
Rollback of deployment from earlier that day completed.

post_incident_summary.summary: A login outage occurred due to a failed authentication deployment. Users could not access their accounts for approximately 17 minutes.
post_incident_summary.root_cause: A faulty deployment to the authentication service caused token generation to fail.
post_incident_summary.timeline: Issue began at 11:58 AM. Detected by Splunk. MI declared by 12:03 PM. Resolved at 12:15 PM via rollback.
post_incident_summary.impact: All users were unable to log in to the Member Website during the outage window.
post_incident_summary.detection: Splunk logs showed increased 401/403 errors, triggering investigation.
post_incident_summary.response: Incident escalated via ServiceNow. MI war room created. Investigation conducted jointly by Internal Applications and SRE.
post_incident_summary.recovery: Rollback of the deployment restored login functionality.
post_incident_summary.prevention_plan: Add automated deployment validation for authentication. Require blue/green deploy for critical login endpoints.

title: API Gateway Latency
description: High latency observed in API Gateway responses.

timeline.description: Logs show increasing response times across multiple services.
15 tickets submitted regarding slow API response.
MI proposed by API Services.
Manager approved the incident as a Major Incident (MI).
Banner: 'We are investigating delays in API Gateway performance.'
War room opened for incident response coordination.
Traffic rerouted to secondary gateway node.

post_incident_summary.summary: Latency across API Gateway services resulted in degraded application performance.
post_incident_summary.root_cause: A misconfigured load balancer introduced high latency across internal API routes.
post_incident_summary.timeline: Latency spike detected at 4:27 AM. MI proposed at 4:32 AM. Mitigated at 4:45 AM by traffic reroute.
post_incident_summary.impact: Customers experienced delayed responses and intermittent timeouts across APIs.
post_incident_summary.detection: OpenSearch logs revealed surging response times across critical services.
post_incident_summary.response: API Services team initiated an MI. War room created. Routing configuration reviewed and updated.
post_incident_summary.recovery: Traffic was rerouted to healthy gateway nodes.
post_incident_summary.prevention_plan: Audit all load balancer configs. Implement synthetic monitoring across API routes.

title: Database Lock Issue
description: Database deadlocks affected several internal tools.

timeline.description: Monitoring showed repeated lock timeout warnings.
11 tickets filed about data entry failures.
MI proposed by Data Engineering.
Approved for immediate MI handling.
Banner posted: 'Some tools may experience errors while saving.'
War room created to address DB locking issues.
Killed stale transactions and restarted locked tables.

post_incident_summary.summary: Deadlock errors in the database caused failures across multiple internal tools.
post_incident_summary.root_cause: Unoptimized queries during peak hours led to lock contention and table deadlocks.
post_incident_summary.timeline: Errors surfaced at 9:11 PM. MI declared at 9:17 PM. Resolved at 9:30 PM by clearing stale locks.
post_incident_summary.impact: Multiple internal teams could not use tools for data entry or report generation.
post_incident_summary.detection: Dynatrace monitoring flagged lock timeout exceptions.
post_incident_summary.response: MI initiated by Data Engineering. War room launched. Query analysis and lock clearance performed.
post_incident_summary.recovery: Problem queries were killed and indexes rebuilt on affected tables.
post_incident_summary.prevention_plan: Refactor queries. Add timeout logic. Conduct DB locking training for engineers.
